about: Six scripted, fictional English-Spanish visits through a remote interpreter, written for Faithful's end-to-end test and demo. 20 interpreter errors are planted on purpose (omissions, substitutions, additions; 11 in the patient's speech, 9 in the clinician's), following the design of Rabotin et al., JMIR Med Inform 2026;14:e88734 (5 scenarios, 20 planted errors). Every other turn is a faithful interpretation, some re-worded the way interpreters normally do. All names are invented.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Hi, I'm Dr. Patel. What brings you in today?
turns.rendition: Hola, soy la doctora Patel. ¿Qué la trae por aquí hoy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Mi hijo tiene fiebre desde hace dos días, y anoche llegó a treinta y nueve y medio.
turns.rendition: My son has had a fever for two days, and last night it got to 39.5.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Has he had any medicine today?
turns.rendition: ¿Le ha dado alguna medicina hoy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Sí, ya le di dos dosis de Tylenol hoy, la última a las diez. Y es alérgico a la penicilina.
turns.rendition: Yes, I gave him Tylenol today.

error.what: Dropped the two prior doses, the time of the last dose, and the penicillin allergy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Is he having any trouble breathing, a rash, or is he not drinking?
turns.rendition: ¿Tiene dificultad para respirar, algún sarpullido, o no está tomando líquidos?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: No, está tomando bien, pero le duele el oído derecho.
turns.rendition: No, he's drinking well, but his left ear hurts.

error.what: Right ear became left ear.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: He has an ear infection. Give him 5 milliliters of azithromycin once a day for 5 days.
turns.rendition: Tiene una infección del oído. Dele 5 mililitros de azitromicina una vez al día por cinco días.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: For the fever you can give ibuprofen, 100 milligrams every 6 hours, but no more than 4 doses in 24 hours.
turns.rendition: Para la fiebre le puede dar ibuprofeno, 100 miligramos cada 6 horas.

error.what: Dropped the dose limit: no more than 4 doses in 24 hours.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: ¿Le puedo seguir dando el Tylenol también?
turns.rendition: Can I keep giving him the Tylenol too?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Yes, but don't give the Tylenol and the ibuprofen at the same time. Alternate them.
turns.rendition: Sí, le puede dar el Tylenol y el ibuprofeno al mismo tiempo.

error.what: 'Don't give them at the same time, alternate them' became 'you can give them at the same time'.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Come back right away if he has trouble breathing, a stiff neck, or won't wake up.
turns.rendition: Regrese de inmediato si tiene dificultad para respirar.

error.what: Dropped two warning signs: stiff neck, won't wake up.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Muchas gracias, doctora.
turns.rendition: Thank you so much, doctor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: How have your sugars been since the last visit?
turns.rendition: ¿Cómo ha tenido el azúcar desde la última consulta?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: En la mañana sale como en ciento cuarenta, pero en la noche a veces baja a sesenta y me pongo temblorosa.
turns.rendition: In the morning it's around 140, and at night it sometimes goes down.

error.what: Dropped the low reading (60) and the shakiness: a sign of low blood sugar.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: How much insulin are you taking at night?
turns.rendition: ¿Cuánta insulina se pone en la noche?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Me pongo veinte unidades antes de dormir.
turns.rendition: I take twelve units before bed.

error.what: Twenty units became twelve.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Let's lower it to 16 units at bedtime, and keep taking metformin 500 milligrams twice a day with food.
turns.rendition: Vamos a bajarla a 16 unidades antes de dormir, y siga tomando la metformina de 500 miligramos dos veces al día con comida.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: ¿Y si me siento mareada otra vez?
turns.rendition: And what if I feel dizzy again?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: If you feel shaky or sweaty, drink half a cup of juice and check your sugar again in 15 minutes.
turns.rendition: Si se siente temblorosa o sudorosa, tómese media taza de jugo y vuelva a medirse el azúcar en 15 minutos.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: También tomo una aspirina diaria que me dio otro doctor.
turns.rendition: I also take an aspirin every day, another doctor gave it to me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Okay. Don't skip dinner on the days you take insulin.
turns.rendition: Muy bien. No se salte la cena los días que se ponga insulina.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Y tengo una herida en el pie izquierdo que no se me cierra.
turns.rendition: And I have a sore on my foot.

error.what: Dropped which foot (left) and that the wound is not healing.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: I want to look at that foot today, before you leave.
turns.rendition: Quiero revisarle ese pie hoy, antes de que se vaya.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: How often is she using her albuterol inhaler?
turns.rendition: ¿Qué tan seguido está usando el inhalador de albuterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Como cuatro veces al día esta semana, y la tos la despierta en la noche.
turns.rendition: About four times a day this week.

error.what: Dropped that the cough wakes her at night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Use two puffs every four hours as needed, and start this steroid inhaler every morning and every night, even when she feels fine.
turns.rendition: Use dos inhalaciones cada cuatro horas si las necesita, y empiece este inhalador de esteroide cada mañana y cada noche.

error.what: Dropped 'even when she feels fine' (the controller must not be stopped).

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: ¿Y el nuevo, cuántas veces se lo doy?
turns.rendition: And the new one, how many times do I give it to her?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: One puff, two times a day. Have her rinse her mouth afterwards.
turns.rendition: Una inhalación, tres veces al día. Que se enjuague la boca después.

error.what: Two times a day became three.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Está bien. Ella no es alérgica a nada.
turns.rendition: Okay. She's not allergic to anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: If her lips turn blue or she can't speak in full sentences, call 911.
turns.rendition: Si se le ponen los labios morados o no puede terminar una frase, llame al 911.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Gracias, doctor.
turns.rendition: Thank you, doctor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Your INR is high today, so we're changing your warfarin dose.
turns.rendition: Su INR salió alto hoy, así que vamos a cambiarle la dosis de warfarina.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Take 2.5 milligrams on Mondays and Fridays, and 5 milligrams on the other days.
turns.rendition: Tome cinco miligramos los lunes y viernes, y dos y medio miligramos los demás días.

error.what: The two doses were swapped between the days.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Ayer me salió sangre de la nariz y no paraba como por media hora.
turns.rendition: Yesterday my nose bled.

error.what: Dropped that the bleeding would not stop for about half an hour.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Any blood in your urine or black stools?
turns.rendition: ¿Ha visto sangre en la orina o el excremento negro?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: No, nada de eso.
turns.rendition: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Para el dolor de rodilla me tomo ibuprofeno.
turns.rendition: For my knee pain I take Tylenol.

error.what: Ibuprofen became Tylenol (ibuprofen raises bleeding risk with warfarin).

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Please stop the ibuprofen. It raises your bleeding risk with warfarin. You can use acetaminophen instead.
turns.rendition: Por favor deje el ibuprofeno, porque con la warfarina aumenta el riesgo de sangrado. En su lugar puede usar acetaminofén.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Come back in one week for another blood test.
turns.rendition: Regrese en una semana para otro análisis de sangre.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Which ankle did you twist?
turns.rendition: ¿Cuál tobillo se torció?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: El izquierdo. Me caí en la escalera el sábado.
turns.rendition: The left one. I fell on the stairs on Saturday.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Me tomé dos pastillas de ibuprofeno de ochocientos.
turns.rendition: I took two ibuprofen pills.

error.what: Dropped the strength: 800 mg each.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: It's a sprain, not a fracture. Ice it for 20 minutes three times a day.
turns.rendition: Es un esguince, no una fractura. Póngase hielo 20 minutos tres veces al día y tome ibuprofeno con cada comida.

error.what: Added 'take ibuprofen with every meal', which was not said.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: You can take ibuprofen 400 milligrams every 8 hours with food, no more than 3 times a day.
turns.rendition: Puede tomar ibuprofeno de 400 miligramos cada 8 horas con comida, no más de 3 veces al día.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: ¿Puedo ir a trabajar? Trabajo parado todo el día.
turns.rendition: Can I go to work? I'm on my feet all day.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Not this week. Keep your weight off it for 3 days and use the crutches.
turns.rendition: Esta semana sí puede. No se apoye en el pie por 3 días y use las muletas.

error.what: 'Not this week' became 'this week you can'.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: If your toes get numb or cold, go to the emergency room.
turns.rendition: Si se le duermen los dedos o se le ponen fríos, vaya a emergencias.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Keep the incision dry for 48 hours, then he can shower.
turns.rendition: Mantenga la herida seca por 48 horas, y después se puede bañar.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: No lifting anything over 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
turns.rendition: Que no levante nada de más de 10 libras por 2 días.

error.what: Two weeks became two days.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: ¿Y para el dolor qué le doy? Es alérgico a la codeína, le da mucha comezón.
turns.rendition: And what do I give him for the pain?

error.what: Dropped the codeine allergy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: Give him acetaminophen, 500 milligrams every 6 hours as needed.
turns.rendition: Dele acetaminofén, 500 miligramos cada 6 horas si lo necesita.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Anoche vomitó dos veces.
turns.rendition: He threw up last night.

error.what: Dropped how many times (twice).

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.source: If he has a fever over 101, the wound gets red or leaks pus, or the vomiting keeps up, come back.
turns.rendition: Si tiene fiebre de más de 101, si la herida se pone roja o le sale pus, o si sigue vomitando, regrese.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.source: Muy bien, muchas gracias.
turns.rendition: Very good, thank you very much.
